record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, condition each HSTU attention gate on the current token: replace gate(attn_out) with value=Wv(attn_out), gate=Wg(normed), and residual dropout(value*SiLU(gate)). This may preserve current-item intent while selectively incorporating history. Retain causal attention, FFN, embeddings, cumulative observed-position IDs, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Train one model per category and synchronize architecture loading through the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Condition each HSTU attention gate on the current normalized token while projecting the attended history separately. This may preserve current-item intent while selectively incorporating history. Applies to all four category models. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so checkpoint shapes and inference remain consistent automatically. Embeddings, positions, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
